title: 3782. Last Remaining Integer After Alternating Deletion Operations

examples.explanation: Write [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] in a sequence. Starting from the left, we delete every second number: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]. The remaining integers are [1, 3, 5, 7]. Starting from the right, we delete every second number: [1, 3, 5, 7]. The remaining integers are [3, 7]. Starting from the left, we delete every second number: [3, 7]. The remaining integer is [3].

Write [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] in a sequence. Starting from the left, we delete every second number: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. The remaining integers are [1, 3, 5]. Starting from the right, we delete every second number: [1, 3, 5]. The remaining integers are [1, 5]. Starting from the left, we delete every second number: [1, 5]. The remaining integer is [1].
Write [1] in a sequence. The last remaining integer is 1.
